question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Chip on the shoulder
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Chip on the shoulder"** means to harbor a grievance or to be easily angered because one feels that one has been unfairly treated. (मनमुटाव रखना)

 
 
• **Example: **Ever since he was passed over for the promotion, he has had a** chip on his shoulder.**
 
 
 
• **"Offended"** refers to feeling insulted or annoyed because of perceived unfair treatment. (अपमानित)
 
 
• **Example: **She felt **offended **when her ideas were dismissed without consideration.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was happy to see her old friends at the reunion.
 
 
 
• **Emotional** (भावुक): Showing strong feelings.
 
 
• **Example: **He became very emotional during the farewell speech.
 
 
 
• **Elated** (प्रसन्न): Extremely happy and excited.
 
 
• **Example:** She was elated when she heard the news of her promotion.
 
 

53:Tc0e,

The correct answer is: Option 3.</
